sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a project informed by the structure of ant colony interiors is among the award-winning Interior Educators' projects. Also included is a project that explores how material choices can create meaningful interior experiences and a proposal to reimagine the former Harbour Mills at Deepwater Quay into a vibrant centre for environmental research.
